name: corridor
short: Shared services and office state for pixel-agents-cogs.
description: Owns shared reply and permission settings, LLM and A2A infrastructure, registered agent tools, and the two opaque revisioned office-state aggregates used by the cctv pages. Other cogs consume these services through required_cogs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores bot-owner configuration for shared LLM/A2A services. It also stores Discord user IDs and registered agent IDs when those identities have avatar appearance or seat assignments in either cctv office-state aggregate.
install_msg: Shared infrastructure every other cog except switchboard needs. Hidden from [p]cog list: install it by name next to them, and they load it automatically. Outside services: LLM requests from the agent cogs go to a LiteLLM endpoint (default https://litellm.nntin.xyz/) once a key is set; it runs the A2A HTTP listener (127.0.0.1:8931 by default) and connects to MCP servers other cogs register. Setup (bot owner): [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model and [p]corridor a2a host/port; permission groups and reply style: [p]corridorsettings.
author: Tin Nguyen
